item.coloph: degedü nom-un mingγan cakirabad-un qutuγ-tu cinggis tang tayisung qaγan-u ǰarliγ-iyar, tegsi bügüde tabun uqaγan-dur mergen tai gung darqan blam-a kiged, pandita qoyar blam-a-yi kereglen sitügsen-iyer, tal kelen-e ücüken medegci bsodpa rgyamcho toyin orciγuluγsan-iyar , delekei-yin eǰen qaγan qamur acitan qamuγ engke esen ǰirγaǰu burqan-u qutuγ-i olqu bolumui .
